lastCompletedStory.title: Rewrite re-home block with getent gid-collision branch

nextStoryContext: US-001 is the only story in this PRD. All stories pass. The re-home RUN block now uses a getent branch to handle GID collisions (e.g. macOS staff=20) without the broken groupmod -n rename guard. A real docker build --build-arg HOST_UID=501 --build-arg HOST_GID=20 smoke test is a separate operator ceremony (CAM-178/183 + CAM-179 + CAM-180 rebuild+verify) and is out of scope for this PRD.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Story only edits a Dockerfile shell RUN block (usermod/groupmod/getent POSIX utilities) and adds a Bun file-assert test. No external npm library was touched.
